values.review.lint.b01: The blind solver chose {solver_choice}, but the key is {key}. Check the key and the wrong options.
values.review.lint.b02: With the options covered, the solver's own answer does not match the key. The question may be ambiguous or lean on its options.
values.review.lint.b02_skipped: The cover-the-options test was skipped: the solver's answer could not be read.
values.review.lint.b03: The solver found a wrong option defensible as a best answer. The question may have two right answers.
values.review.lint.b04: Some claims in the explanation are not backed by the cited study excerpts. Cite them or remove them.
values.review.lint.l01: Do not use "all of the above", "none of the above" or "both X and Y" as an option.
values.review.lint.l02: The lead-in is negative ("{words}"). Ask for the one best answer instead of the exception.
values.review.lint.l03: The wording uses absolute or vague-frequency terms ({words}). Use precise values or conditions.
values.review.lint.l04: The lead-in must be a single closed question that ends in a question mark and can be answered with the options covered.
values.review.lint.l05: The key is much longer than the other options ({key_length} characters against {mean_distractor_length} on average), which gives it away.
values.review.lint.l06: The key repeats more of the stem's words than any wrong option does, which gives it away.
values.review.lint.l07: The key looks most like the other options (convergence), which gives it away. Make the wrong options as specific.
values.review.lint.l08: The options are not in alphabetical or numerical order.
values.review.lint.l09: The numeric options mix units or formats, or their ranges overlap.
values.review.lint.l10: The options are not all the same kind of thing (for example, a mix of diagnoses, drugs and tests).
values.review.lint.l11: A grammatical cue points at one option: the article or number before the options does not fit them all.
values.review.lint.l12: The vignette order is off. Give history, vitals and examination before laboratory and imaging results.
values.review.lint.l13: A laboratory value is missing its units, is implausible, or disagrees with the reference table ({values}).
values.review.lint.l14: The stem is too short (recall only) or too long. Aim for a vignette of 40 to 250 words ({words} here).
values.review.lint.l15: The stem refers to another question. Each question must stand alone.
values.review.lint.l16: The question is too similar to one already in the bank or to a known public item (similarity {similarity}).
values.review.lint.l17: The stem names a demographic detail without saying why it matters. Remove it or add the rationale.
values.review.lint.l18: The solver's confidence ({confidence}) does not match the requested difficulty ({requested}).
values.review.lint.s01: The question must have exactly five options, labelled A to E, each filled in. It has {count}.
values.review.lint.s02: The answer key ({answer}) is not one of the options.
values.review.lint.s03: A required part is missing: the explanation, a reason for every wrong option, or the educational objective.
values.review.lint.s04: The taxonomy tags are incomplete or unknown: it needs a system, a discipline or clinical science, a competency and a topic.
values.review.lint.s05: A source this question cites is missing or may not be used for AI-written questions.
values.review.lint_clean: The linter found nothing to report.
